name: Paytm

snapshot.about: Digital payments, financial services, commerce and cloud technology platforms.

narrative: Management delivered top-line momentum with Q2 FY27 revenue growing 28.5% to ₹2,648 crore and EBITDA margin reaching 10%, aligning with revenue acceleration targets. However, cash flow from operations remains negative and unit economics for Postpaid and marketing services lack detailed disclosures.

promises.statement: Management expects revenue growth to accelerate across payments, financial services, and marketing services in FY27.

said.quote: So, in addition to what Vijay said about marketing services and sort of addressed your question, yes, we expect that to be a contributor going forward

actual_source.quote: For example, if you grew 28% YoY, are there any downward pressures on revenues at all in the foreseeable future

promises.note: Revenue growth reached 28% in Q1 FY27 and 28.5% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Paytm targets adding 25 to 30 lakh merchants annually.

said.quote: So we have said broadly 25 to 30 lakhs additions a year

promises.statement: Management targets achieving 15% to 20% EBITDA margins in about two and a half to three years.

said.quote: And EBITDA, we will maintain about two and a half to three years from now, that we should be able to get to those sorts of EBITDA margins

promises.note: Management reiterated the 15-20% EBITDA margin target over 2-3 years in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: Paytm Postpaid unit economics are expected to stay within 20 bps of previous levels.

said.quote: we expect this to be within 20 bps, give or take of what we had earlier

promises.statement: Marketing services revenue is expected to grow from current levels.

said.quote: we are at bottom or near bottom, and we should expect this to grow

promises.statement: Company GMV growth is expected to be higher than 20% if overall UPI grows at 20%.

said.quote: We do think that if UPI is growing at 20%, our GMV growth should be higher than that

actual_source.quote: it was like 23 odd percent in Q3, went to 27 percent in Q4, now 31 percent

promises.statement: Indirect costs are expected to remain range bound for the rest of FY26.

said.quote: for the rest of the year, we expect this to be range bound

promises.statement: Management expects EBITDA to be significantly higher than capex in FY27.

said.quote: On question number three, it is the case that we have capex, but next year we expect EBITDA to be significantly higher than capex

actual_source.quote: The thing is that we probably announced 8% of EBITDA margin this quarter

promises.statement: Paytm expects Buy Now Pay Later monthly disbursals to cross 100 crore INR within six months of launch.

said.quote: And within six months of launch, we expect to cross hundred crores of disbursal

promises.statement: Paytm expects to offset at least 30-40% of the PIDF impact in Q4 FY26.

said.quote: Our expectation is at least 30 - 40 percent of this will be offset this quarter and more over time

signals.quote: Operating cash flow was negative in FY26 while reported profit was positive.

cash.read: Profits fail to translate into cash. Operating cash flow was negative in FY26 despite reported profits, and free cash flow was negative across all five years, totaling −₹3,832 crore.

bull.point: Revenue growth accelerated to 28% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 28.5% in Q2 FY27, with EBITDA margin improving to 10%.

evidence.quote: For example, if you grew 28% YoY, are there any downward pressures on revenues at all in the foreseeable future

bull.point: GMV growth expanded to 31% YoY in Q1 FY27, accelerating from 23% in Q3 FY26 and 27% in Q4 FY26.

evidence.quote: it was like 23 odd percent in Q3, went to 27 percent in Q4, now 31 percent

bull.point: Paytm maintains strong liquidity with ₹13,500 crore of cash on its balance sheet as of Q1 FY27.

evidence.quote: not only do we have INR 13,500 crores of cash, we are now also adding a significant amount of cash

bear.point: Auditor report highlighted an emphasis of matter regarding an Enforcement Directorate show cause notice alleging FEMA contraventions against the company.

evidence.quote: We draw attention to Note 41 to the standalone financial statements, regarding a Show Cause Notice ("SCN") received by the Company and its two subsidiaries, from the Directorate of Enforcement

bear.point: Free cash flow has been consistently negative over five years totaling −₹3,832 crore, alongside negative operating cash flow in FY26.
